_about: L00 follow-up of C02 (docs/knowledge/C02.md §9): login layouts from annotations.json with official opcode names (opcodes.json) and field names from the 2017 PDB where the 2016 login code agrees on offsets and sizes (0x0C5A checked in FUN_00406450, 0x0C66/0x0C67 in FUN_004060d0). Overrides the 'login' entries of annotations.json.

0x0807.name: NC_MISC_SEED_ACK
fields: XOR keystream index starts at seed % 499

0x0c65.name: NC_USER_CLIENT_VERSION_CHECK_REQ
fields: strncmp(64) against lines of Login/ClientVersionKeyInfo.txt ("20151116141627") (pdb2017 name)
0x0c65.notes: client FUN_0046eb30 sends it right after receiving the seed, with the hard-coded key "20151116141627"; L00 name was 'version check'

0x0c67.name: NC_USER_CLIENT_RIGHTVERSION_CHECK_ACK
0x0c67.notes: client FUN_0046f470: on receipt, opens the login UI and sends 0x0C04; L00 name was 'version OK'

0x0c66.name: NC_USER_CLIENT_WRONGVERSION_CHECK_ACK
0x0c66.notes: Empty struct PROTO_NC_USER_CLIENT_WRONGVERSION_CHECK_ACK (pdb2017). The server sends payload size 1 (Pkt_SetOpcode(…,0xc66,1)) and never writes that byte: C++ sizeof of an empty struct, not a field. Client FUN_0046eec0 shows: 'You client version is different from the Server version. Please restart the client after patching.' L00 name was 'version rejected'

0x0c5a.name: NC_USER_US_LOGIN_REQ
0x0c5a.basis: FUN_00406450; total packet length must be 0x13E
fields: server copies at most 256 bytes; bytes 256..259 are never read (pdb2017 name; 2016 code agrees on offset/size)
Name5 union; forwarded to AccountDB (0x0C5B) uninterpreted, read as 5 × u32 (pdb2017 name; 2016 code agrees on offset/size)

0x0c37.name: NC_USER_LOGIN_WITH_OTP_REQ
0x0c37.basis: FUN_00406bb0; total packet length must be 0x22
fields: must exist in the table filled by WM message 0x0C35

0x0c09.name: NC_USER_LOGINFAIL_ACK
fields: client shows the text from its global error table (FUN_00416430): 0x42 'An unknown error has occurred.', 0x43/0x46 'DB error', 0x44 'Authentication failed.', 0x45 'Please check ID or Password.', 0x47 'The ID has been blocked.', 0x48 'The World Servers are down for maintenance.', 0x49 'Authentication timed out. Please try to log in again.', 0x4A 'Login failed.', 0x4B 'Please accept the agreement to continue.', 0x51 'You are not in our service area.'; other codes (0x4C, 0x4E, 0x52) -> 'An unidentified error code has occurred.: <code>'
0x0c09.notes: session is closed afterwards; L00 name was 'login failed'

0x0c1b.name: NC_USER_WORLD_STATUS_REQ
0x0c1b.notes: answered with 0x0C1C (same layout as 0x0C0A); L00 name was 'world list refresh'

0x0c0c.name: NC_USER_WORLDSELECT_ACK
fields: client FUN_0046ef20: 0 'Server is closed', 1 'Server is under maintenance', 2 'You cannot connect to an empty server', 3 'The server has been reserved for a special use', 4 'Login failed due to an unknown error', 5 'Server is full', 6-10 = OK, connect to WM
read by the client (FUN_008c7850); not visibly written by the Login decompile, so it is filled in a way the extractor missed
client stores it and sends it to WM in 0x0C0F

0x0c04.name: NC_USER_XTRAP_REQ
0x0c04.basis: client FUN_0046f470; server FUN_00406230 does not check it
fields: "33B543B0CA6E7C41E5D1D0651307" + NUL, hard-coded in the client (pdb2017 name)

0x0c17.name: NC_USER_CONNECTCUT_CMD
fields: 0x683 = same account logged in elsewhere (client remembers it in a flag)
